recommendations.text: Compare distinct offer/value, decision-support and next-step messages. sources.title: R5 bounded allocation policy
sources.rule: Keep one paid channel and one objective. Hold 10% in reserve. Under $500 or $20/day avoid a separate retargeting slice; above both, allocate 10% only with user-reported usable audience and explicit retargeting request. Flag under $10/day as thin. Three angles, days 1/mid/end checks; no separate testing campaign.
